proposed_widenings.name: dual_stream_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Wall has two mechanically distinct streams that must both be represented honestly: (1) an instantaneous STR save → 4d8 Bludgeoning on appearance (activation-shaped), and (2) persistent ongoing environmental/travel-blocking effects for the full concentration duration (ongoing_effect-shaped). No existing family covers both simultaneously. Encoding only one stream produces a misleading trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. [AND] The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall.

proposed_widenings.name: area_shape_wall
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Wall creates a linear wall (up to 50 ft long × 15 ft high × 1 ft thick, continuous path along ground). The existing Attachment area shape only supports { kind: 'sphere'; radiusFeet: number }. A wall shape (length × height, path-shaped) is required. This is a surface_widening on the Attachment type and will recur for Wall of Fire, Wall of Ice, Wall of Stone, Wall of Thorns, Blade Barrier, etc.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground.

proposed_widenings.name: deflect_projectile
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Wall passively auto-misses ordinary ranged projectiles (arrows, bolts) aimed at targets on the far side of the wall. This is neither block_travel (movement) nor interrupt_resolution (reaction-based) nor block_targeting (targeting prevention). It is a passive area-gated automatic miss on attack resolution — a distinct effect with no v4 atom. Boulders and siege projectiles are explicitly excluded (ruling-level filter), which makes this mechanic even more specific.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and miss automatically. Boulders hurled by Giants or siege engines, and similar projectiles, are unaffected.

proposed_widenings.name: block_gas_passage
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Wall blocks fog, smoke, gas-type environmental effects AND creatures in Gaseous Form from passing through. The existing block_travel atom covers creature movement but has no creature-type or substance filtering (Small-or-smaller flying, gaseous). A filtered block_travel variant or a distinct block_gas_passage atom is needed; the distinction matters because Boulders pass freely while gaseous matter does not.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay. Small or smaller flying creatures or objects can't pass through the wall... Creatures in gaseous form can't pass through it.

notes: The primary blocker is structural: Wind Wall is neither a pure activation spell (like Fireball — single-shot save+damage) nor a pure ongoing_effect spell (like Bless — persistent modifier with no instantaneous component). It requires both streams simultaneously. Even if the structural widening were resolved by introducing a new family (e.g., activation_with_ongoing or a dual-stream composition), the encoding would still require (a) a wall area shape variant and (b) a deflect_projectile atom not in v4. The gas-blocking could potentially be folded into a widened block_travel with size/type filters, but the auto-miss on ranged attacks crossing the barrier is a genuinely novel mechanic. No Dhall or JSON produced per protocol.
